[[File:The Meniscate.png|right|200px|thumb|The Meniscate]]
{{Quote|When the moon's face was wounded, these words appeared.|Meniscate Invocation}}
'''The Meniscate''', also called '''The Mirror-Queen''', is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XI, or 11:00am. Her [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, and {{Lore|Lantern}}. She is one of the four offspring of [[The Sun-in-Splendour]], and is said to have been The Sun's "night-self". In the aftermath of the Intercalate, she was born from the Moon. Her face is like a mirror, and "one point" of it was wounded at her birth. She favours balance, and rules a secret reflection of the Mansus which can be accessed through a hidden door in the Wood.

==Notes==
*[[Way: Through the Stag Door#The Ascent of Knives|The Ascent of Knives]] is said to be sacred to both [[The Sun-in-Rags]] and The Meniscate, but for unknown reasons [[Maid-in-the-Mirror|Maids-in-the-Mirror]] are said only to serve The Sun.
*Like The Sun-in-Rags, the Meniscate has been known to walk in [[Way: The White Door#The Orchard of Lights|The Orchard of Lights]].
*[[Streets Strange by Moonlight]] is a phenomenon produced by the influence of The Meniscate.
